links.outcome: Extraction accuracy across prompting techniques and ensemble voting
links.effect: Single-model accuracy 17.5%-30.3% and highly prompt-dependent; ensemble voting improved overall accuracy to 83.6%, peaking at 90.0% for resection type.
links.quote: The voting strategy improved performance significantly, with 83.6% overall accuracy, peaking at 90.0% for the resection type variable.

unlisted_practices: ensemble majority voting across multiple LLM outputs to improve extraction accuracy
format and keyword validity filtering of LLM outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates prompting techniques and an ensemble voting method for extracting clinical variables from Polish oncology EHR notes using small LLMs, benchmarked retrospectively against oncologist annotations.
